tbesh_html:
1) to be bright, be beautiful, be handsome, be fair
1a) (Qal) to be beautiful
1b) (Piel) to beautify
1c) (Pual) to be beautiful
1d) (Hithpael) to beautify oneself

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to be bright, i.e. (by implication) beautiful
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be beautiful, be (make self) fair(-r), deck.
